records.name: Python datetime.date and timedelta Addition

interpretation.description: date objects can only be added to timedelta objects. Adding an integer directly throws TypeError.
interpretation.example: import datetime; d = datetime.date(2026, 11, 16); result = d + datetime.timedelta(days=30)

validation_rules: Ensure right-hand operand is wrapped in datetime.timedelta(days=...)

records.name: Python Naive vs Aware datetime Comparison Restriction

interpretation.description: In Python 3, comparing a timezone-naive datetime with a timezone-aware datetime raises TypeError: can't compare offset-naive and offset-aware datetimes.
interpretation.resolution: Either attach timezone using dt.replace(tzinfo=...) or convert to UTC via dt.astimezone(datetime.timezone.utc)

validation_rules: Normalize all datetime objects to UTC before comparison
